body.x: YUJIN SYSTEM(representative Sang-jung Shin, www.yujinsys.co.kr) will show varied CCTV-related machine at CES 2012 held from Jan 10-13.
(Picture: Camera housing and electric rotation machine all-in-one product 'YSPC-360')

High speed panorama Pan/Tilt Camera ‘YSPC-360’, a main product, can allow the clear image to user even the objective is at a long distance by using 37times high magnification zoom lens, especially it's a infrared light and LED all-in-one type, so it can be used at night without separate light source.

In addition, surveillance of Dead zone is available for 24 hours with four assistance camera. Above these, there are many functions including 444 times digital zoom, alarm input/output, Smart Pan/Tilt Drive.

YUJIN SYSTEM has been focusing on development and production of CCTV peripheral including camera housing, electric rotation machine, infrared light and others since 1986 establishment. They achieved quality and environment management system certification ISO 9001/14001.
